## About

Systems builder and software engineer based in India. Started with cryptography and blockchain protocols — deep focus on deterministic logic and execution accuracy. Transitioned into full-stack products specialising in state synchronisation, browser automation scrapers, and orchestration systems.

Currently building Hunter — an autonomous browser agent that translates natural language goals into self-healing browser execution scripts.

Open to work. 3+ years building.

## Projects

### Hunter

An autonomous AI browser agent that translates natural language goals into self-healing browser execution scripts.

Status: Active Alpha  
Timeline: Ongoing  

Problem: Procedural web bots fail instantly when layouts shift, class names update, or buttons change labels, causing broken workflows and high support overhead.

Solution: Built a self-healing selection router integrating visual coordination meshes with semantic DOM elements, letting the model target action fields even after code updates.

Architecture: Planner Engine → Vision Mapper → Execution Channel → Reflection Engine

Technical contributions:
- Autofill Layout Mapper
- Multi-Agent Executor Loop
- Local Cache Database
- Chrome Extension Core

Metrics: 94% target accuracy, <1.2s fill speed, 88% autofill rate

Technologies: JavaScript, Chrome Extensions API, Manifest V3, Gemini API, OpenAI API, Vision Models, IndexedDB

URL: https://huntterr.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/pandeYtushal

---

### Smart Civic Platform

A localised complaint logging platform bridging public residents with municipal administrators.

Status: Live  
Timeline: 2026  

Problem: Municipal reporting apps fail in the field because users try to upload high-resolution images over weak 3G/LTE signals, leading to timed-out requests.

Solution: Implemented local pre-processing using HTML5 Canvas to downscale and compress images directly in the browser. Payloads are shrunk by 70% before hitting the Firebase Storage pipeline.

Architecture: Canvas Compressor → Firebase Upload Queue → Firestore Sync Engine → Admin Status Board

Technical contributions:
- Realtime ticket logging and status updates using Firebase Auth & Firestore.
- Client-side image scaling utilising HTML5 Canvas context scaling.
- Mobile-first responsive report form with status trackers and admin tools.

Metrics: 70% size compression, <50ms alert latency, Realtime sync engine

Technologies: React.js, Tailwind CSS, Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Firebase Storage, JavaScript (ES6+)

URL: https://urban-utiliy-report.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/pandeYtushal

---

### Melody Premium

A music streaming web app with glassmorphic UI and PWA support for mobile-first experience.

Status: Live  
Timeline: 2026  

Problem: Standard web music players interrupt audio playback during page navigation or fail when network bandwidth fluctuates, resulting in a choppy listening experience.

Solution: Hoisted the audio playback engine to a global React context backed by Zustand for state tracking. Service workers pre-cache adjacent tracks, enabling zero-latency track switches.

Architecture: Zustand Media Store → HTML5 Audio Engine → Service Worker Pre-caching → Saavn API Sync

Technical contributions:
- Integrated JioSaavn API for high-quality audio fetching and recommendations.
- Firebase Auth with Google Login integration.
- Zustand store tracking persistent queues, volumes, and routes.

Metrics: 10M+ track index, Zustand state sync, <0.3s load latency

Technologies: React 19, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Firebase Auth, JioSaavn API, Axios, Vite

URL: https://meldmusic.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/pandeYtushal

### Astronomical

A multimedia web archive documenting the history of Indian mathematical astronomy, celestial models, and architectural observatories spanning 1,500 years.

Status: Live
Timeline: 2026

Problem: The rich history of Indian mathematical astronomy — spanning Vedic astronomy, the Aryabhatiya, Jantar Mantar, and ISRO — lacks a single visually coherent web archive.

Solution: Built a Next.js 15 multimedia archive with Framer Motion cinematic transitions, a d3-geo abstract observatory map, and scroll-velocity physics driving the historical timeline experience.

Technical contributions:
- Cinematic 3D gallery with physics-based scroll-velocity driven timeline.
- Abstract coordinate map of historical observatories using d3-geo projections.
- Detailed archive pages for scholars — Aryabhata, Brahmagupta, Bhaskara II.
- Modern Space Era section covering ISRO achievements including Chandrayaan and AstroSat.

Technologies: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, d3-geo, Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Mono

URL: https://astronomical-chi.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/pandeYtushal/Astronomical

## Development Journey

### 2023 — Foundation
Started Development: Solidity & Decentralised Web3 Systems
- Designed cryptographic scripts and smart contracts on Ethereum networks.
- Explored standard structures for decentralised client execution logic.
- Built clean computational routines using pure Solidity structures.

### 2024 — Growth
Full Stack Projects: React, Zustand, and Realtime Database Synchronisation
- Designed Melody, a high-fidelity streaming platform featuring zero-flash route cache states.
- Built municipal tracking registers synced in realtime via Firestore caching.
- Optimised load times to sub-200ms using local asset indexing.

### 2025 — Breakout
AI Agents: Structured Reasoning & Multi-Model Orchestration
- Orchestrated custom model router hubs dynamically selector-swapping client queries.
- Built browser automation scrapers utilising coordinate models.
- Developed structured JSON API parsers formatting text results.

### 2026 — Present
Building Hunter: Flagship Autonomous Browser Automation Agent
- Architecting self-healing DOM selectors resolving real-time app shifts.
- Orchestrating concurrent sub-agents coordinating planning, browser, and memory nodes.
- Deploying client extension architecture bypassing captcha blockages.
